scope: Pre-Chat production renderer with repaired benchmark-only transport fixtures
fixtureChanges: Use original session.next.text.* event contract with stable text part ID and timestamps.

The benchmark finite-response queue emits one server.connected greeting per endpoint/origin; subsequent response batches do not simulate reconnects that replace the streamed text with the static HTTP fixture.
unchanged: Benchmark loads, CPU throttle, repeat count and retries

history.reason: Correct event names alone did not repair repeated greeting invalidation.
Observed repeated server.connected greetings force static HTTP refetch; diagnostic instrumentation was not integrated.

limitations: Controlled production-browser benchmark, not an installed Microsoft Team or personal provider observation.
Three repeats per scenario describe this runner; they are not a statistical guarantee or an invented release threshold.
Streaming scenarios use CPU throttle 30, 320 history turns and 160 deltas. The isolated review scenario has its own recorded load.
Finite HTTP response batches model the benchmark event queue; this is not a physical continuous-SSE network benchmark.
No visual profiling claim: the run recorded geometry and DOM identity.
